Store a memory.

USAGE
  sennit remember --context <text> [flags] <statement>

FLAGS
  --context text     What makes the statement resolvable on its own (required)
  --type type        One of fact, preference, insight, doc, profile, correction
                     (default fact)
  --tags list        Comma-separated tags; prefer specific ones, and reuse the
                     vault's existing vocabulary
  --supersedes id    The id of a record this one replaces
  --flush            Write to Sia before returning instead of leaving the
                     record queued (default true; --flush=false leaves it
                     queued)

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir         Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url      Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline          Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when       When to colour output: auto, always or never (default
                     auto)
  --verbose          Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit remember --context "why it matters" "the statement"
  $ sennit remember --type preference --tags cli,ui --context "choosing a CLI look" "Prefers one live status line"

Flags go before the statement.
